[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Isabella was born in 1837. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-3543|David Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-3544|Agnes Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1877.

Isabella Glasgow married [[Traill-482|Thomas William Traill]] on 29 April 1862.  She passed away in 1877 without leaving any children.<ref name=frotoft>Thomas William Traill, ''[https://archive.org/details/frotoftbranchofo00trai/page/12/mode/2up The Frotoft branch of the Orkney Traills]''. Orkney, Scotland: privately printed, 1902.  Page 13-14.</ref><ref name=traills>William Traill of Woodwick, MD. ''[https://archive.org/details/agenealogicalac00unkngoog/page/n74/mode/2up A Genealogical Account of the Traills of Orkney]''.  Kirkwall: J. Calder, 1883.  Pages 58-59.</ref><ref name=elsie>Ritchie, Elsie.  ''A Collected History of the Traill/Trail Family'', 2nd Ed.  Australia: privately printed, 2010.  Page 260.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
See notes for her husband Thomas; depending on further research, it could be that her father was David Glasgow.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3543]] is assessed at 87% (probable). Isabella’s 1837 Manchester birth/christening and 1862 marriage notice citations support the held David/Agnes parent account. The Traill genealogies add a specific family context, but no held literal clause ties her father to the 1804 Bute child.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect Isabella’s 1837 baptism and 1862 marriage father occupation.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NGK8-GV1 "England, Births and Christenings, 1538-1975", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NGK8-GV1 : 4 February 2023), Isabella Glasgow, 1837.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
